check_box.label: Enable procedural sunset sun
check_box.name: procedural_sun_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Fills transparent areas of the active EEP sun with a soft viewer-local disc near the horizon. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Appearance angle (degrees)
slider.name: procedural_sun_start_angle
slider.tool_tip: Sun elevation where the procedural disc begins fading in. It reaches peak visibility near 2 degrees. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_start_angle
button.tool_tip: Reset appearance angle to its default value

color_swatch.name: procedural_sun_final_color
color_swatch.tool_tip: Warm color applied mainly to the softened solar limb near the horizon; the core remains white-hot. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_final_color
button.tool_tip: Reset horizon limb color to its default value

slider.label: Brightness / color
slider.name: procedural_sun_brightness
slider.tool_tip: From 0 to 1, blends the configured sunset color toward a white-hot sun without darkening it. Above 1, boosts emitted intensity. Use the checkbox to hide the disc. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_brightness
button.tool_tip: Reset brightness and color to its default value

slider.label: Edge feather
slider.name: procedural_sun_feather
slider.tool_tip: Softens the final sun silhouette, including an opaque EEP sun texture. Zero retains pixel antialiasing only. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_feather
button.tool_tip: Reset edge feather to its default value

slider.label: Horizon shimmer
slider.name: procedural_sun_shimmer
slider.tool_tip: Adds subtle animated atmospheric-refraction ripples to the final sun silhouette below five degrees elevation. Zero disables the motion. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_shimmer
button.tool_tip: Reset horizon shimmer to its default value

slider.label: Horizon halo strength
slider.name: procedural_sun_halo_strength
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the warm additive halo that fades in during the final two degrees above the horizon. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_halo_strength
button.tool_tip: Reset horizon halo strength to its default value

slider.label: Horizon halo radius
slider.name: procedural_sun_halo_radius
slider.tool_tip: Outer halo radius measured in sun-disc radii. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_halo_radius
button.tool_tip: Reset horizon halo radius to its default value

slider.label: Horizon halo softness
slider.name: procedural_sun_halo_softness
slider.tool_tip: Fraction of the halo radius used for its progressive outer fade. Higher values make the boundary more diffuse. Changes are applied live.

button.name: reset_procedural_sun_halo_softness
button.tool_tip: Reset horizon halo softness to its default value

slider.label: Azimuth
slider.name: as_sun_azimuth
slider.tool_tip: Sets the sun azimuth using a local environment override.

slider.label: Elevation
slider.name: as_sun_elevation
slider.tool_tip: Sets the sun elevation using a local environment override.
